title: Why Bullets Are Slow
text: The reason traditional guns cannot shoot much faster is rooted in thermodynamics.
nxt: A bullet is propelled by the expanding gas of burning gunpowder, and that expanding gas cannot push the bullet any faster than the speed of sound within the hot gas itself.
